name: Sidelit
description:
The GNOME side of Sidelit, a workspace sidebar for coding agents (Claude Code).

Sidelit puts every workspace in a sidebar on the left, one tab each, with the agent working there. GNOME has no way for an app to see or arrange other windows, so this extension does that part:

* it tells Sidelit which workspaces and windows there are, over D-Bus, and switches, adds, keeps, reorders and removes workspaces, and focuses, moves and closes windows when Sidelit asks
* it runs Sidelit's sidebar while Sidelit runs, keeps it on the left of the screen on every workspace, and reserves that strip so maximized windows end beside it

It needs the Sidelit app (the sidebar and its daemon); on its own it does nothing. It stays on while the screen is locked, so the workspaces Sidelit keeps are still there when you come back.
